items.text: When we invest in R&D, it encourages American ingenuity. I am proud to lead the bipartisan charge to ensure that American companies and workers can stay competitive on the world stage. https://t.co/OT3RWwNKXP

I visited with doctors and staff at Precision Surgery Center in Wichita to discuss the services and care they provide to Kansans & the challenges they face, particularly with rising costs and insurance. They provided excellent health care insight I'll share with my colleagues. https://t.co/PEJPWbi7OR

As Americans struggle to stretch the same dollars to do more, they have a right to know how much a health care visit will cost them. At yesterday’s @WaysandMeansGOP hearing I highlighted how price transparency can help patients who are struggling with rising costs from inflation. https://t.co/DUtKCITSKF

.@WaysandMeansGOP voted to release the testimony of credible IRS whistleblowers who approached the committee with serious allegations about the President's son. We'll continue to exercise our oversight capacity and hold the Biden administration accountable.

Last week's @WaysandMeansGOP markup was an important step toward improving the prior authorization process – these changes will save money and improve the delivery and quality of care for patients. https://t.co/WHMZJTGf05
Susan and I are praying for our friend, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, as he begins treatment for Multiple Myeloma. He's a fierce fighter and we'll be standing with him.

Last week I joined a roundtable discussion with rural health care providers and hospitals at SCK Medical Center, which is pursuing the designation of rural emergency hospital to better serve its patients. These providers are a critical resource for our rural communities. https://t.co/jMd1TtslMS

As a past board member, I saw firsthand how Wichita's Hunter Health Clinic cares for countless patients in our community, including those who are unable to pay. I was excited to visit recently and see plans to expand the clinic's space, so they can keep caring for patients. https://t.co/Q95i3xjYBa

The Heart Valve Clinic at Ascension Via Christi St. Francis is just one of five locations globally to test certain heart valve procedures. I'm impressed with their advanced work and was glad to listen to challenges about recruiting doctors and nurses, and dealing with insurance. https://t.co/isE2Ehqyzu

Kansans are still suffering because bureaucrats in the swamp have distorted Congressional intent in implementing the No Surprises Act. At today's @WaysandMeansGOP hearing, I called on @CMSGov  to correct course and put patients first. https://t.co/WxDKrMxfaW

.@housebudgetGOP's proposal shows it's possible to craft a budget that preserves essential services, like Medicare and Social Security, while balancing our budget. It's irresponsible to continue to borrow $1 out of every $5 we spend – our proposal offers a strong course correct. https://t.co/GedoRoUKiS

Biden's border crisis is also fast-tracking our spending crisis. Medicaid spending on “emergency services for undocumented aliens” exceeded $7 billion in the last year alone – just a fraction of the billions of dollars being spent because of Biden's open borders.

HSAs put patients in control of their health care – I spoke in support of @WaysandMeansGOP bills that expand access to this critical tool by giving access to currently ineligible Americans, covering direct primary care services and increasing the max contribution limit. https://t.co/GoRNQ0Dl0Z

October is Down Syndrome Awareness Month. No matter how many chromosomes, each life is a unique gift with unique values. This year, I introduced legislation so that doctors do not knowingly perform an abortion due to a prenatal diagnosis of Down Syndrome. 
https://t.co/IXO15oCY3u https://t.co/fijRE1fypN

Taking the lead from bipartisan legislation passed by @WaysandMeansGOP, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services has taken action to improve and streamline the prior authorization process, which will improve seniors' access to timely and quality care.

In today's @WaysandMeansGOP hearing I discussed the risks of relying on medical manufacturing in China and the imperative need to secure access to lifesaving drugs, especially for patients in rural areas. All Kansans deserve the same access to high quality care and treatments. https://t.co/NHonw1lBdw

As I discussed with Wichita physician Dr. Richardson in last week's @WaysandMeansGOP hearing, patients in rural Kansas already suffer from a lack of access to medical specialists, and now inflation is threatening the independent providers who travel to run clinics in rural areas. https://t.co/1Dmuzc3l9z

Early detection saves lives, which is why I cosponsored the Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act that @WaysandMeansGOP passed this week. This bill will allow Medicare to cover new cancer screenings that test for multiple cancers. https://t.co/4jCIq7West

At Ardent Mills I learned about their Emerging Nutrition division that uses research & development to expand consumer choices. Producing 2.7 million pounds of flour per day, it was impressive to see these hardworking Kansas farmers who feed our community and the world in action. https://t.co/dpgeTiM1z4

During my visit to Cypress Imaging, I was impressed to see the advancements they've made to make the imaging process more comfortable and accessible, including a mobile unit to better serve rural patients and nursing home patients. https://t.co/wPJW2ur33w

Last week I visited Enhabit Home Health and Hospice and was impressed to see the personalized care staff provide to patients, including in their home. We also discussed the barriers and challenges, particularly from insurance, to providing this care and how to overcome them. https://t.co/P324HLaQcG
